integrity: General theorem is proved by projection geometry; small exhaustive programs corroborate but do not certify the infinite family. Earlier rank-one directed annihilation counts and n=2 regularity are credited as prior results.
scientific_limitations: Proof covers n >= 2, all finite field orders q. Strict degree monotonicity concerns n >= 3. It does not extend by assertion to nonmatrix rings, all finite rings, or arbitrary skew fields. Independent-priority coverage beyond inspected sources cannot be guaranteed.
title: Degree rigidity and ring reconstruction from finite-field idempotent annihilation graphs
